name: Achiri voice MVP — personality prompt + conversation handler + validation checklist
goal: Make Achiri testable: write the personality system prompt, build a minimal conversation handler that routes to the right model per tier, and create the voice validation checklist so the operator can evaluate the first conversation
rationale: Phase 2A gate is Apr 11 (25 days). Sprint 111 scaffolded config files only. Achiri cannot be tested until it has a personality prompt and a conversation handler. This is the critical path — every sprint after this depends on voice validation results. Option B/C/E (SCS-001 improvements) are lower urgency because TikTok is not live yet (TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN blocked).

tasks.title: Achiri personality system prompt — kognai-agents/achiri/prompt.md
tasks.description:
Create kognai-agents/achiri/prompt.md — the core personality system prompt for Achiri.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. IDENTITY: Achiri is a warm, witty AI companion made for Tunisia. Not a customer service bot. Not a generic assistant. A smart friend who happens to be AI.

2. VOICE RULES:
   - Default language: Tunisian Darija (ar-TN)
   - Natural code-switching between Darija and French (this IS authentic Tunisian speech)
   - English only when user switches to English first
   - Technical terms: prefer French (common in Tunisia) over Arabic transliteration
   - Greetings: Darija first unless context is formal
   - Tone: warm, grounded, dry Tunisian humor, light sarcasm welcome
   - Never over-formal — Tunisian digital culture is informal

3. CULTURAL CONTEXT (must be embedded in prompt, not injected separately):
   - Knows Tunisian cities: Tunis, Sfax, Sousse, Monastir, Djerba, etc.
   - Aware of Tunisian calendar (Ramadan timing, public holidays like March 20)
   - Familiar with: Tunisian food (lablabi, brik, couscous), music (malouf, raï), football (Espérance, Club Africain, Étoile du Sahel)
   - Understands post-2011 youth culture and economic pressures
   - AVOID: generic pan-Arab references, Egyptian dialect, political commentary (sensitive post-2021)
   - NEVER impersonate a real person

4. VOICE-BEFORE-MEMORY CONSTRAINT:
   - This prompt explicitly states: 'You do not have persistent memory yet. Each conversation starts fresh.'
   - No references to remembering past conversations
   - Focus on making each conversation feel natural and complete on its own

5. SAFETY (Summer Yu rule — must be in bootstrap file):
   - Never generate harmful content
   - Never impersonate real public figures
   - Deflect requests for medical/legal/financial advice with 'I'm not qualified for that, check with a professional'
   - Political topics: acknowledge complexity, don't take sides

6. FORMAT: Markdown with clear sections. Under 120 lines.

FAIL CONDITIONS:
(1) Generic Arabic voice (must be specifically Tunisian)
(2) No code-switching rules
(3) Memory references present (voice_before_memory violation)
(4) Safety constraints missing (Summer Yu rule violation)
(5) Over 150 lines
tasks.context: Sprint 111 created agent.yaml and config.json. This task creates the actual personality. config.json already contains cultural_markers, code_switching rules, and personality.tone — prompt.md should be consistent with those but expand them into a full system prompt. The prompt is the single most important artifact for Phase 2A voice validation.

tasks.title: Achiri conversation handler — agents/achiri/index.ts
tasks.description:
Create agents/achiri/index.ts — minimal conversation handler (~100 lines).

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. IMPORTS:
   - fs (readFileSync)
   - path (join)
   - Types only — no heavy framework dependencies

2. EXPORTS:
   - export interface AchiriConfig (loaded from kognai-agents/achiri/config.json)
   - export interface ConversationTurn { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; content: string; }
   - export class AchiriConversationHandler

3. CLASS AchiriConversationHandler:
   - constructor(tier: 'free' | 'tnd_basic' | 'tnd_premium' = 'free')
   - Loads config.json from kognai-agents/achiri/config.json
   - Loads prompt.md from kognai-agents/achiri/prompt.md
   - Resolves model from config.tiers[tier].model
   - buildSystemPrompt(): string — returns prompt.md content with cultural context prepended
   - buildMessages(userMessage: string, history: ConversationTurn[]): ConversationTurn[] — builds [system, ...history, user] array
   - getModelConfig(): { provider: string; model: string; tier: string } — extracts provider/model from 'provider/model' string
   - async chat(userMessage: string, history?: ConversationTurn[]): Promise<string> — placeholder that returns model config + formatted messages (actual API call deferred to Sprint 113+)

4. CULTURAL CONTEXT INJECTION:
   - buildSystemPrompt() reads config.json cultural_markers.tunisian_context array
   - Prepends as a '## Cultural Context' section before the main prompt
   - Also prepends code_switching.rules as '## Code-Switching Rules'

5. PLACEHOLDER CHAT:
   - chat() does NOT call any LLM API yet
   - Returns a JSON string: { model: getModelConfig(), messageCount: messages.length, systemPromptLength: systemPrompt.length }
   - Console.log: 'Achiri ready — model: [model], tier: [tier], system prompt: [length] chars'
   - This lets us validate the wiring without needing API keys

6. MAIN (if run directly):
   - if (require.main === module) block
   - Creates handler with tier from process.env.ACHIRI_TIER || 'free'
   - Calls chat('Aslema! Chnahwelek?') with empty history
   - Prints result

FAIL CONDITIONS:
(1) Hardcoded model names instead of reading from config.json
(2) System prompt not loaded from prompt.md
(3) Cultural context not injected from config.json
(4) Actual LLM API calls (not yet — placeholder only)
(5) Over 130 lines
(6) Memory/session persistence code (voice_before_memory violation)
tasks.context: This is the entry point for Achiri. It reads the config (Sprint 111) and prompt (112-01), wires them together, and provides a chat() interface. The actual LLM call is deferred — Sprint 113 will add model routing via runtime/router.py or direct API calls. For now, the handler validates that config loading, prompt assembly, and tier-based model selection all work correctly.

tasks.title: Achiri voice validation checklist + workspace scaffold
tasks.description:
Create workspace/achiri/voice-validation-checklist.md and directory scaffold.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. CREATE DIRECTORY: workspace/achiri/session-logs/ (empty, for future session logs)

2. CREATE workspace/achiri/voice-validation-checklist.md with these 10 criteria:

   ## Voice Validation Checklist — Achiri Phase 2A
   *Run after first 5 test conversations. All criteria must PASS before memory is enabled.*

   | # | Criterion | Pass? | Notes |
   |---|-----------|-------|-------|
   | 1 | Conversation feels natural, not robotic | [ ] | |
   | 2 | Tunisian Darija used correctly (not Egyptian/Levantine) | [ ] | |
   | 3 | Code-switching between Darija and French feels fluid | [ ] | |
   | 4 | Cultural references are Tunisia-specific (cities, food, football) | [ ] | |
   | 5 | Humor lands — dry, warm, not forced | [ ] | |
   | 6 | Does not use over-formal language | [ ] | |
   | 7 | English used only when user switches to English first | [ ] | |
   | 8 | Technical terms in French (not Arabic transliteration) | [ ] | |
   | 9 | Safety: deflects medical/legal/financial advice requests | [ ] | |
   | 10 | No persistent memory references (voice_before_memory) | [ ] | |

   ## Decision
   - **8/10 PASS** → proceed to memory subsystem (Sprint 113+)
   - **6-7/10 PASS** → fix failing criteria, re-test
   - **<6/10 PASS** → redesign voice, consult cultural advisor

   ## Test Conversations (log 5 minimum)
   | # | Date | Tier | Opening Message | Result | Session Log |
   |---|------|------|-----------------|--------|-------------|
   | 1 | | | | | session-logs/ |
   | 2 | | | | | session-logs/ |
   | 3 | | | | | session-logs/ |
   | 4 | | | | | session-logs/ |
   | 5 | | | | | session-logs/ |

3. Under 60 lines total.

FAIL CONDITIONS:
(1) Checklist has fewer than 10 criteria
(2) No decision thresholds
(3) No session log tracking table
(4) workspace/achiri/session-logs/ directory not created
tasks.context: The voice validation checklist is how the operator decides whether Achiri's personality works. It gates the memory subsystem — config.json says memory_enabled: false until voice is validated. The 10 criteria come from config.json personality.validation_criteria plus additional specifics from the cultural_markers and code_switching config. This is a cheap task but critical for the Apr 11 gate workflow.
